about_the_game:
Thomas wants to overcome his past with Emily, and to do so he seeks professional help in order to leave his memories behind.

Remembering Emily is a visual novel in which we will discover the relationship between Thomas and Emily through a series of key encounters between the two protagonists over time, thus understanding the reasons behind their dramatic destiny.

The player will live the strange romance remembered by Thomas as he tells it to Noah, the professional who is helping him, and must actively decide at certain crucial moments to discover what really happened.

Depending on the decisions you make, the game will change its course, offering two completely different endings. Once you have seen both... you will understand the hidden truth behind Emily and Thomas' relationship.
